t: Master Of Light - Walmart.com
Master of Light: how one man went from poverty to prison to painting | Documentary films | The Guardian
s: November 16, 2022 - Escape artist: the life of a painter living on death row ... Morton spent his entire 20s in federal penitentiaries, serving an 11-year sentence for drug charges. While locked up, he found comfort and therapy in art, honing his craft and painting striking portraits that are regularly compared to those by Rembrandt. The Dutch painter’s chiaroscuro style, playing with light and shade, becomes a visual motif in both Morton’s life and work. In Master of Light, Morton walks through the European art space like a disruptive presence, a Black man in his camo jacket gliding through museums where no one like him adorns the walls.
